FIX BUG #369: A v2 policy table loads a misspelt rule key silently, so an artifact gate or a condition can vanish

You are fixing exactly one bug from the code-health epic (#330) on branch fix-369-v2-rule-keys, already checked out in this worktree off origin/main. The issue text is below and is the whole framing: its "Fix" and "Acceptance" sections are what done means. Where the issue says the operator rules between options, implement the option the issue recommends (or the first listed), keep it small, and say in your result notes which option you took so the pull request can ask for the ruling.

RULES
- Scope: fix this bug and nothing beside it. Follow-ups go in your notes, not in the diff. Prefer targeted edits over rewrites.
- Tests: add or extend the suite that proves the fix. Assert exact values and exact error variants or text, never is_err() alone. Show every new test binds: make a compiling mutation that removes the fix, run the test and see it fail, restore the fix, and record the failing test name in your notes.
- Coverage: the repository enforces literal 100% line, branch and function coverage (scripts/coverage-exact.sh), which the controller runs after you; do not run that script. Keep every new line and branch reachable by a test. If a branch cannot be reached deterministically, restructure rather than leave it uncovered.
- Frozen surfaces do not move: contracts/, policy/phase-machine.json, fixtures/, reference/. Decisions 0001 and 0003 stand. Hosts are Linux and macOS only (decision 0063): add no Windows code.
- Every witness digest your change moves is re-pinned from the tests' own reported values, never computed by hand.
- Gates before you report complete, all clean: cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings; cargo test for every crate you touched (crate-scoped: cargo test -p <crate>); git diff --check.
- Commit when done: one commit, signed off (git commit -s), message "<area>: <what changed> (#369)" in the repository's style, ending with the line "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>". Never push.
- Evidence: every claim in your notes points to a command you ran in this session and what it printed. Anything you did not observe is pending, not done.

THE ISSUE (#369), verbatim:

Found by the code-health sweep (epic #330). Verified on `main` at `ba52724e` (2026-09-25).

## What happens

`parse_rule` (`crates/brokkr-core/src/policy.rs:287-402`) reads the keys it knows with `obj.get` and **never enumerates `obj.keys()`**. A v2 policy table with a misspelt rule key loads without complaint:

- `requires_artifact` (singular) loads the rule **with no artifact gate**.
- A misspelt `when` loads the rule as **unconditional**. The unreachable-rule check (`:180-189`) catches this only when a later rule for the same (from, result) pair exists.
- A misspelt `severity` silently becomes `normal`.

`contracts/phase-machine.v2.schema.json` declares `additionalProperties: false` with 9 rule keys, but it is only byte-pinned (`crates/brokkr-runtime/tests/frozen_contracts.rs:153`) and never applied.

## Why it matters

ARCHITECTURE.md promises that "a misspelt key refuses to load". That holds for condition keys but not for rule keys. An artifact gate or a condition can vanish from the constitution with no signal: fail-open in the one module whose law is fail-closed.

## Scope and safety of the fix

- 8 live tables are v2: `bundles/self` plus 7 recipes, 147 rules in all.
- All 195 shipped rules were scanned. Only the frozen v1 `policy/phase-machine.json` uses keys outside the nine (`source`, `terminal_for_ship`). **Closing v2 breaks nothing that ships.**

## Fix

Gate the rule vocabulary by version, exactly as `park` already is (`policy.rs:335-342`). Refuse any non-contract key in v2, with an explicit key check or a `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] RuleV2` DTO. v1 stays open, because the frozen table carries annotation keys.

## Acceptance

- A v2 table containing `requires_artifact` is refused at load, and the error names the key and the rule id.
- Every shipped recipe and bundle still compiles, and their digests are unchanged.

Rust-only architecture is recorded by decision 0009. Semantic changes carry a
decision document with status `proposed` because only the operator accepts one.
Intake seats read `README.md` and decisions 0004 and 0005 before framing a
commission, along with the code and history it touches.

The frozen v1 contracts under `contracts/`, the production table at

edit. The evaluator corpus under `fixtures/` is also frozen and is never
regenerated, only versioned.

`cargo test --workspace`, compile `bundles/self`, and leave formatting, clippy,
and the exact-coverage gate clean before reporting success.

push.

publishes them. Local validation is preparation work. Remote CI on the final PR
head, publication, channel updates and live-profile verification are handoff

"live from" channel versions and old journal examples are historical facts,
not current-version references to replace.

result.notes: Fixed #369 in commit 429f8ec2 (signed, signed off, not pushed). Option taken: the issue's explicit key check, not a deny_unknown_fields DTO. parse_rule (crates/brokkr-core/src/policy.rs) now refuses, in a table declaring forge.phase-machine/v2 only, any rule key outside the nine the v2 contract lists (new const RULE_KEYS_V2). The error text is "rule <id> declares '<key>', which is not forge.phase-machine/v2 rule vocabulary". v1 and tables with no schema stay open. New test policy::tests::a_v2_rule_refuses_a_key_outside_its_vocabulary_and_v1_stays_open asserts the exact error for requires_artifact, whenn, severty and source in v2. It also checks that the same rules still load in v1 and with no schema, and that a v2 rule using all the real keys keeps its gate, severity and condition. Binding: I changed the guard to schema == Some("MUTATED") and the test FAILED (panicked at tests.rs:372). Restoring the guard made it pass. Gates: cargo fmt --all -- --check clean; git diff --check clean; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -D warnings finished clean; cargo test -p brokkr-core: all suites ok (74 lib tests). cargo test -p brokkr-runtime: all suites ok, including witness_digests and table_lints, so digests did not move and nothing was re-pinned. cargo test -p brokkr-cli --test recipes --test machine_proof: 61 + 10 passed. compile --bundle bundles/self gives digest 697b7a2e…; compile --bundle bundles/verify gives b10e1f47…; both succeed. Pending: the full brokkr-cli suite (I ran only the recipes and machine_proof targets because of the known hang in the workspace run), cargo test --workspace, and scripts/coverage-exact.sh, which the controller runs. Every new branch should be reachable by the new test and the existing v2 park tests, but coverage was not measured here. Follow-up, left out of scope: the table-level keys of a v2 table are not closed either. The contract's top level has no additionalProperties:false, so that needs a ruling first.

members.adversarial: Adversarial review of commit 429f8ec2 vs origin/main ba52724e: only crates/brokkr-core/src/policy.rs (+24) and src/policy/tests.rs (+38). I tried to break the fix and found no concrete inputs->wrong-output defect. (1) The new v2 gate at policy.rs:327-334 refuses an unknown rule key and names key and rule id; the exact error is asserted by policy::tests::a_v2_rule_refuses_a_key_outside_its_vocabulary_and_v1_stays_open, which I ran and saw pass. (2) I extracted the rule property names from contracts/phase-machine.v2.schema.json (id,from,result,next,park,severity,requires_artifacts,reason,when; additionalProperties:false) and compared: they equal RULE_KEYS_V2 exactly, all nine are actually read by parse_rule, so no allowed key is silently dropped and no legit key is rejected. (3) I scanned every JSON in the repo (excluding target/.git): exactly 8 v2 tables (147 rules, bundles/self + 7 recipes) and none uses a key outside the nine; only the frozen v1 policy/phase-machine.json carries source/terminal_for_ship and it stays open. cargo test -p brokkr-runtime --test table_lints (6 passed) loads every shipped table and every extends compose through Machine::from_table. (4) Composition cannot smuggle v1 annotation keys into a v2 table: compose.rs:718-727 refuses layers with differing schema, and every extends chain is v2->v2. (5) Digests did not move: cargo test -p brokkr-runtime --test witness_digests (4 passed) and recipes_that_opted_into_nothing_keep_their_digests passed. (6) Coverage of the new code: outer v2 true (misspelt/full) and false (v1 and no-schema cases in the new test), inner Some (misspelt) and None (full rule), closure true (misspelt) and false (allowed keys) are all exercised. (7) Binding, from the test's own v1/no-schema assertions: the same misspelt key loads fine without the gate, so if the v2 gate is removed Machine::from_table returns Ok and unwrap_err() panics; the implement note records exactly that with the MUTATED guard failing at tests.rs:372. (8) Probes I dropped as non-findings: an absent/typoed schema string is treated as v1-open by documented convention (recipe-authoring.md) and the v2 contract requires an exact schema, so it is not a v2 table; an unknown key on a rule that also misses a required field is still refused, just under the missing-field error; top-level table keys (e.g. shippable_from) remain open, but the v2 contract root has no additionalProperties:false and the implementer recorded it as an out-of-scope follow-up. Gates I ran: cargo fmt --all -- --check exit 0; git diff --check exit 0; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings exit 0; cargo test --workspace --all-features --locked exit 0. The fix and its test satisfy the #369 Acceptance; verdict clean.
